content: We need number of aromatic carbons in the sample's molecule. We have no SMILES given. We need to get NMR spectra maybe to infer aromatic carbons count. Could use carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR, then count aromatic carbon signals (around 120-150 ppm). But we don't have the sample defined; maybe the environment has a default sample. The tools don't require input. So we can call carbon_nmr_spectra.
